toc.title: Clarissimo adolescenti D°. Roberto Dormer, Baroni de Wing
Concio habita ad artium baccalaureos 22o Feb. 1626. In die Cinerum.

book: A single academic oration (Concio) printed at Oxford in 1626, with a title page, a dedicatory epistle to Robert Dormer, Baron Dormer, and the oration text, which has no internal headed divisions beyond numbered points.
